```python
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None:
            return
        try:
            v = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return
        if not np.isfinite(v):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(v, 1) if metric in ("share", "rank") else round(v, 2),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    num = ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
           "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]
    for c in num:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    # ---- Totals ----
    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", rev_tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", rev_lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", rev_ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if rev_lw and rev_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", (rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if rev_ly and rev_ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", (rev_tw - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_TW)")
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if u_lw and u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", (df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True) - u_lw) / u_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if o_lw and o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", (df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True) - o_lw) / o_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # ---- Top entities by revenue ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(5).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for this product")
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")):
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", r["Share_Pct"],
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if len(top):
        add(top.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", 1.0, "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    # top 5 concentration
    if rev_tw and rev_tw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", top.head(5)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100,
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # ---- Biggest absolute WoW movers ----
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    up = d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(3)
    for _, r in up.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
    down = d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=True).head(3)
    for _, r in down.iterrows():
        if r["abs_wow"] < 0:
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # ---- Biggest percent WoW movers (material base) ----
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct", "Revenue_LW"])
    p = p[p["Revenue_LW"] >= 100]
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=True).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- Biggest YoY movers ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct", "Revenue_LY"])
    y = y[y["Revenue_LY"] > 0]
    for _, r in y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
    for _, r in y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=True).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # ---- Volume leaders ----
    ut = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"]).sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False)
    if len(ut):
        add(ut.iloc[0]["Entity"], "units", "TW", ut.iloc[0]["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW)")
    ot = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"]).sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False)
    if len(ot):
        add(ot.iloc[0]["Entity"], "orders", "TW", ot.iloc[0]["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW)")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
